outcome: Placental expression levels of high mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) protein
Placental expression levels of vascular cell adhesion molecule-1 (VCAM-1) protein
cohort: The study included 40 pregnant women complicated with GDM and 40 healthy pregnant women, from whom placental tissues were obtained.
finding: Placental HMGB1 expression was significantly increased in the GDM group compared to the control group, while placental VCAM-1 expression was statistically similar between groups.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth, on placental tissues obtained following cesarean delivery.
